name: @matatbread/matbot-tool-router
description: Serves the model a bounded per-turn window from a large tool library via a ToolPresenter: always-present wide fallbacks (pins) + the BM25-top tools for the current message + a tool_search entry point (with a de-duped noun catalogue) for the tail. Tool width (pin vs rank) and the catalogue are derived per tool from its description + inputSchema and cached in a store; tools already used or revealed are read back from the session transcript rather than re-presented, so the wire stays cache-friendly and coherent under session edits. Cross-platform (node + browser).
